api_version.description: Exact supported content/script API major version.

conflicts.description: IDs which cannot be enabled at the same time as this package.

content.description: Relative path to the JSON content pack. Defaults to `content.json`.

dependencies.description: Required mod IDs mapped to semantic version requirements.

id.description: Unique lowercase namespace; `base` is reserved for the original game.

name.description: Display name shown in the in-game manager.

scripts.description: Relative paths to every Rhai source referenced by this content pack.

version.description: Semantic package version, saved together with a SHA-256 content hash.
